lines.text: On the Sabbath, the disciples pick and eat grain in the fields, and the Pharisees say this is unlawful.
Jesus says David entered God's house, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, lawful only for elders.
Jesus says One greater than the temple is here and the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.
In the synagogue, Jesus tells a man with a withered hand to stretch it out, and it is restored.
The Pharisees plot to kill Jesus, so He withdraws and heals the crowds, fulfilling what Jeremiah spoke.
